Seymour (SEYM) Mesonet observation. Winds gusted to 58 mph or higher from 1754 PM LST to 1818 PM LST. There were frequent gusts over 90 mph between 1800 and 1809 PM LST. Southwest winds gusted to 100 mph at 1801 PM LST, and north winds gusted to 106 mph at 1808 PM LST.
